patch:
@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@ runs:
   using: composite
   steps:
     - name: Set up Node.js v24
-      uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6.5.0
+      uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
       with:
         node-version: "24"
         cache: ${{ inputs.npm-cache == 'true' && 'npm' || '' }}

@@ -99,7 +99,7 @@ runs:
     - id: credentials
       name: Assume the test data read role
       if: inputs.fetch == 'true' && steps.cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
-      uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@7474bc4690e29a8392af63c5b98e7449536d5c3a # v4.3.1
+      uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@e1253824e5c10ff9df46874f81ed3ec929e19cfd # v6.3.0
       with:
         role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/github-actions-test-fixtures-read
         aws-region: us-east-2

@@ -63,7 +63,7 @@ jobs:
           persist-credentials: false
 
       - name: Set up uv
-        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@37802adc94f370d6bfd71619e3f0bf239e1f3b78 # v7.6.0
+        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3
 
       # Every file carries licence information and every licence it names has its text in LICENSES/.
       - name: REUSE lint
@@ -147,7 +147,7 @@ jobs:
         run: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate
 
       - name: Install cargo-audit
-        uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2.88.0
+        uses: taiki-e/install-action@1919c4a95903d2c33e4a221102edca87309fc14b # v2.89.0
         with:
           tool: cargo-audit

@@ -154,7 +154,7 @@ jobs:
         run: npm run build:js
 
       - name: Set up uv
-        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@37802adc94f370d6bfd71619e3f0bf239e1f3b78 # v7.6.0
+        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3
 
       # The php and blade tool-packs run their upstream under the exact PHP their runtime pins, and Composer installs it.
       - name: Set up the pinned PHP and Composer
